title: Settings (M6)
brief: Settings screen of goop (/settings): full screen with two panes, a short category list on the left (Search preferences, Schedule, Appearance, Keys, Privacy & data opens M13, About) and the fields of Search preferences on the right as terminal form rows (role keywords, seniority and work mode as inline radios, locations, minimum salary, languages, show offers from score). The focused field takes the selection style and in edit state shows a lavender composer input; dim notes say what goop does with each field. Unsaved changes are a header tag; key hints follow the focus (↵ edit green, ctrl+s save, u undo change, tab next pane, esc back, ? all actions) and the unfocused pane keys are muted. Settings are stored encrypted on this machine and never sent anywhere. Status line with the settings focus mode. Below the screen: the save toast with undo, the Schedule category preview and the ask when leaving with unsaved changes.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: Two panes with plain label/value form rows, edit in place through a lavender composer and an explicit save (header tag, ask on leave); hides the chat and edits long values one line at a time
